headline: A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar
text:
A drift game where your EV battery is your health bar.

Weight-transfer physics, regen braking, and zombie bounties—built in a single index.html file.

Zero downloads. Instant 0.1s load:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html
#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 5-second looping GIF showing the car countersteering through a snow biome drift, green regen sparks charging the battery meter, and a clean overtake.
